_comment: Examples under datrix/examples/ that the REAL generation pipeline cannot GENERATE today.
This is a DELIBERATELY MAINTAINED SCOPE BOUNDARY, not an auto-heal: it is the only sanctioned
reason for a registered example to have no generated tree when the cross-language
every registered language's corpus under <workspace>/.generated is complete.
KEY FORMAT: a bare example_id (the example's path under datrix/examples/ with '/' replaced
by '-') parks the example for every registered language -- for a failure at
config-resolution/deployment-plan-building time, before any language-specific codegen stage
runs. An 'example_id::language' key parks that one language only -- for a defect in one
language's own codegen stage while the same example generates fine in every other language.
A compile failure of generated output is NEVER a park reason: whether generated output
compiles is the generated tier's proof (the generated project's own tests, run-complete.ps1,
generate.ps1 at STANDARD), and the artifact-role gate reads the pipeline's manifests, which
exist whether or not the tree later compiles.
All entries reproduce with the sanctioned generator (generate.ps1 <system.dtrx> <out> -L <language>),
so none is a gate artifact. The gate fails loudly the moment a parked pair HAS a generated
tree, so a stale entry cannot survive the defect it records. Removing an entry means the
defect is FIXED; the example then simply has to be generated like every other one.
